_source: Measured for issue #923 by audit/harness.py (untracked audit workspace) on master commit c8b3bbe. Raw per-run JSON: audit/results/uc923_*.json. Cache bytes are the cache's own array sizes (nbytes), not bit-width accounting.

caveats: Single run per method; quality is deterministic, timings drift ~2x between processes, so no speed claim is made from these rows except 'several times slower' for RVQ.
Perplexity 'prefill' is measured on the prefill path, before eviction applies. Eviction quality is the decode-phase columns, over only 32 tokens (paired dNLL standard errors are wide).
turboquant_rvq compresses keys only; values stay fp16. Its key-only compression ratio is not a full-cache figure.
Peak memory is the process peak (weights + cache + prefill transients), so it moves much less than cache bytes, and rose for streaming_llm.

synthetic_bounded_cache_check._source: One layer, 8 KV heads x head_dim 128, random fp16 tensors, 1,024-token prefill then 1,024 single-token decode steps, master c8b3bbe. Cache keys+values nbytes read at prefill and each 25% of decode.
